title: tests/containers_conf.bats: generalize /dev/shm size rounding for any…
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind failing-test

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Commit 331c046d510ade3ca090e161871470120499150b
("tests: Adapt test to work on systems with 64k page size") hardcoded
a check for 64k pages, which still fails on systems with page sizes
other than 4k and 64k.

/dev/shm is a tmpfs mount, and when mounting tmpfs with a "size" option,
the kernel rounds the limit up to a multiple of PAGE_SIZE (via
DIV_ROUND_UP(size, PAGE_SIZE) in shmem_parse_one() in mm/shmem.c).
tmpfs(5) documents this: "The size is given in bytes, and rounded up to
entire pages."

Compute the expected size by rounding 200k up to the nearest page boundary.

#### How to verify it

On a host with 16k pages:

```Bash
cd tests && bats -f '/dev/shm' containers_conf.bats
```
This failed before the change and passes now.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

None
